entries.title: Claude crewmates no longer credit Claude in commits and pull requests
entries.body: A crewmate on your Claude subscription no longer adds a line naming Claude as a co-author to its commits. Its pull request descriptions no longer end with a line saying Claude made them. A crewmate that was already at work before the update may still add them. A crewmate on another computer stops adding them once that computer is updated.
entries.noPicture: The change shows in the commits and pull requests a crewmate writes in your project, not on the app's screen.
